name: STEM Educ8 2018

venue.name: STEM Educ8
venue.details: Enter through the side door facing Principle Row. Extra parking will be available in the warehouse across the street.

information:
$15 entry fee for competitors, free for spectators. Pre-payment online, no walk-ins, no refunds. When the registration fills up, we will have a wait list and accept people in the **order they paid**. When registration closes, we will refund those that have paid for their place on the waiting list. If you find out you can't go please let us know so we can remove you from the registration and allow somebody in from the waiting list!

4x4, Megaminx, and Square-1 Round 2 are tentative.

The venue for this competition was provided by STEM Educ8.
